'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[Senate Majority Leader]] [[Mitch McConnell]] blocks an attempt by [[United States Senate|Senate]] [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]] to increase the direct payments from [[United States dollar|$]]600 to $2,000. However, McConnell also said that the Senate will consider a process to provide $2,000 in stimulus checks to [[Americans]], a measure that is supported by both Democrats and [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/mcconnell-blocks-senate-democrats-move-pass-2-000-coronavirus-checks-n1252483 (NBC News)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/mcconnell-senate-2000-stimulus-checks-2020-12 (''Business Insider'')]
*The first commercial [[Boeing 737 MAX]] flight in the United States since [[Boeing 737 MAX groundings|worldwide groundings]] began in March 2020 occurs. The flight, between New York City's [[LaGuardia Airport]] and [[Miami International Airport]], was operated by [[American Airlines]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/12/29/737-max-returns-to-the-us-after-deadly-crashes.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020 Petrinja earthquake]]
**A magnitude 6.4 [[earthquake]] strikes [[Petrinja]], [[Croatia]], destroying half of the town. Several other cities in the country are also affected. At least seven people are killed, five of whom were in [[Glina, Croatia|Glina]], one in Petrinja, and one in [[Žažina]]. Several others are also injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55474230 (BBC News)]
**The [[Krško Nuclear Power Plant]] in neighboring [[Slovenia]], which produces around 20 percent of [[Energy in Slovenia|the country's electricity]], is shut down as a precaution. Preventive inspections at the plant are ongoing. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/slovenia-nuclear-plant-shut-after-6-2-magnitude-earthquake-in-neighbouring-croatia-2345189 (AFP via NDTV)] [https://www.iaea.org/newscenter/pressreleases/iaea-informed-by-slovenian-authority-that-krsko-nuclear-power-plant-in-safe-shutdown-following-earthquake (IAEA)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
******[[Vice President–elect of the United States|Vice President-elect]] [[Kamala Harris]] and her husband [[Doug Emhoff]] receive the [[Moderna]] [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/kamala-harris-doug-emhoff-covid-vaccine/ (CBS News)]
*****[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that three more officials will join his [[COVID-19 Advisory Board]]. [https://www.politico.com/amp/news/2020/12/29/biden-coronavirus-response-coordinators-451996 (Politico)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] extends a regional [[stay-at-home order]] in [[Southern California]] and the [[San Joaquin Valley]] due to rise of hospitalizations in the state. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/stay-home-orders-extended-california-covid-cases-surge-n1252519 (NBC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Colorado]] reports the United States' first case of a new variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]] from the [[United Kingdom]]. The patient is a man in his 20s who is in isolation in [[Elbert County, Colorado|Elbert County]] and has no travel history. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/coronavirus-variant-colorado-us/2020/12/29/8e6379fc-4a01-11eb-a9f4-0e668b9772ba_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana]]
*****[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[2020 United States House of Representatives elections|U.S. congressman-elect]] [[Luke Letlow]] of [[Louisiana]]'s [[Louisiana's 5th congressional district|5th congressional district]], who was scheduled to be sworn-in to the upcoming [[117th United States Congress]] on January 3, 2021, [[List of deaths due to the COVID-19 pandemic|dies]] from [[COVID-19]] complications after previously [[COVID-19 testing|testing]] positive for the disease, becoming the first member-elect of the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] to die [[List of United States representatives-elect who never took their seats|before taking office]] since former astronaut [[Jack Swigert]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/29/luke-letlow-covid-congress-452218 (Politico)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kentucky]]
*****[[Governor of Kentucky|Governor]] [[Andy Beshear]] announces that the [[Kentucky|state]] will extend its [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]] for another 30 days after reporting 2,990 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.wkyt.com/2020/12/29/watch-live-gov-beshear-gives-update-on-covid-19/ (WKYT-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports a record 2,553 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, along with 1,939 new cases yesterday, bringing the total number of confirmed cases in the province to 175,908. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7545388/ontario-coronavirus-cases-december-28-and-29-covid19/ (Global News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Quebec]] reports its first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a person who had been in contact with a family member who travelled from the United Kingdom on December 11 and tested positive for COVID-19 on December 13. [https://montrealgazette.com/news/local-news/first-case-of-new-coronavirus-variant-reported-in-quebec (''Montreal Gazette'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland]]
*****[[Northern Ireland]] reports a record 1,566 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases in the country to 68,762. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2020/1229/1186861-northern-ireland-covid/ (RTÉ)]
****A record 53,135 new cases are reported in the [[United Kingdom]] in the past 24 hours. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/uk-hospitals-struggle-tougher-rules-eyed-fight-variant-74948834 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] reports a record 1,546 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 88,439. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/covid-19-nine-deaths-and-1-546-cases-reported-in-record-tally-1.4446936 (''The Irish Times'')]
****Ireland officially begins a [[vaccination]] programme against COVID-19 using [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]]'s [[tozinameran]] vaccine, with a 79-year-old woman from [[Dublin]] becoming the first person to receive the vaccine. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2020/1229/1186763-covid-vaccination/ (RTÉ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Belarus]] begins vaccinations with [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/12/29/belarus-starts-coronavirus-vaccination-with-sputnik-v-a72512 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Denmark]] extends its hard [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] until January 17 due to substantial increases in numbers of cases and hospitalizations in the country. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/denmark-extends-hard-lockdown-until-jan-17-amid-spike-in-infections (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 40 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 859. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/29/south-korea-reports-record-deaths-govt-secures-new-vaccine-deal (Al Jazeera)]
****[[United States Forces Korea]] begins a [[vaccination]] programme against COVID-19 using the [[Moderna]] [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. Healthcare providers and first responders are among those who will initially receive the vaccine. [https://www.stripes.com/news/pacific/health-care-providers-first-responders-for-u-s-forces-korea-receive-coronavirus-vaccine-1.656738 (Stars and Stripes)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[India]] reports six cases of a more contagious variant of SARS-CoV-2 in individuals who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]] and are now in isolation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-55472333 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Japan]] reports its first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from [[South Africa]] in a 30-year old woman who arrived in Japan on December 19 and later tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/12/29/national/japan-south-africa-variant/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Pakistan]] reports its first cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the [[United Kingdom]]. The patients are three people who travelled from the UK to [[Sindh]] and later tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/new-coronavirus-variant-detected-in-pakistan/article33445058.ece (''The Hindu'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]] 
****The [[Philippines]] extends its travel ban to 19 "flagged" countries and territories from midnight until January 15 in order to prevent [[Variants of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|new variant]]s of SARS-CoV-2 from entering the country. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-philippines-travel-ban-new-virus-strain-13859316 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****The [[United Arab Emirates]] reports the first case of new variant of SARS-CoV-2 originated from the United Kingdom. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/health/covid-19-uae-confirms-new-coronavirus-variant-cases-1.1609254696008 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], 501.V2 variant
****[[Queensland]] reports Australia's first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from [[South Africa]] in a woman who arrived in the state on December 22 and later tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-12-29/coronavirus-queensland-records-first-case-south-african-strain/13010534 (ABC Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa]]
****The [[government of Samoa]] suspends travel from the United Kingdom and South Africa in response to a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in those countries. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/433737/samoa-new-travel-advice-stops-uk-and-south-africa-travellers (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****Argentina begins a vaccination campaign using the Russian [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://www.europapress.es/internacional/noticia-argentina-inicia-campana-vacunacion-contra-coronavirus-rusa-sputnik-20201229133549.html (Europa Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Chile]] reports its first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a resident of [[Panguipulli]] who traveled from [[Madrid]] on December 23. '''International relations'''
*[[United Kingdom–Vietnam relations]]
**The United Kingdom and [[Vietnam]] sign a [[free trade agreement]], which will take effect on December 31, following a meeting between UK [[Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs|Foreign Secretary]] [[Dominic Raab]] and his Vietnamese counterpart [[Pham Binh Minh]] at the [[State Guest House (Vietnam)|State Guest House]] in [[Hanoi]], Vietnam. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-eu-vietnam/vietnam-britain-sign-free-trade-deal-to-take-effect-dec-31-idUKKBN2931I3?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Shooting of Tamir Rice]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice]] announces it will not [[criminal charge|charge]] the two [[Cleveland Division of Police|Cleveland police officers]] who killed Tamir Rice. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/no-federal-charges-officers-2014-fatal-shooting-tamir-rice-doj-n1252506 (NBC News)]
*[[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]], [[Killing of Breonna Taylor]]
**The [[Louisville Metro Police Department]] announces that they will [[dismissal (employment)|fire]] Joshua Jaynes and Myles Cosgrove, two of the officers involved in the botched raid of [[Breonna Taylor]]'s home. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/29/us/louisville-officer-fired-jaynes-breonna-taylor.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Investigative Committee of Russia]] accuses opposition leader and anti-corruption activist [[Alexei Navalny]] of fraud for allegedly using public funds from his organization for personal needs. The accusation comes after the federal prison service demanded that Navalny report to its office today or face jail time. [https://www.dw.com/en/russia-opens-new-criminal-probe-against-alexei-navalny/a-56088559 (DW)]
*[[Jonathan Pollard]], a convicted spy who spent 30 years in prison in the [[United States]] for spying, returns to [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/jonathan-pollard-arrives-in-israel-35-years-after-his-imprisonment-for-spying/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/29/jonathan-pollard-spy-israel-452235 (Politico)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Algeria]]
***[[President of Algeria|President]] [[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] returns to [[Algeria]] following treatment in [[Germany]] for COVID-19 since November. [https://www.barrons.com/news/algeria-president-returns-after-2-month-covid-19-treatment-01609270804?tesla=y (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Abortion in Argentina]]
**[[Voluntary Interruption of Pregnancy Bill (Argentina)|Voluntary Interruption of Pregnancy Bill]]
***The [[Senate of Argentina|Senate]] begins to debate the legalization of [[abortion]] up until the 14th week of pregnancy. If passed, Argentina will become the third [[Latin America]]n country to allow abortion to be performed on demand, after [[Cuba]] and [[Uruguay]]. The [[Catholic Church]] opposes the move. The bill has already been approved by the [[Argentine Chamber of Deputies|lower house]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-abortion/argentinas-senate-poised-to-vote-on-legalizing-abortion-rare-in-region-idUSKBN293109?il=0 (Reuters)]
